from flowguard.intent import rule, row


@rule("DEPOSIT_REVIEW", decides="deposit needs manual approval",
      fields={"deposit": int, "member": bool},
      source="owner R1: 会员也一样，不能例外。", anchor="APPROVAL")
def DEPOSIT_REVIEW(deposit, member):
    return deposit > 100


DEPOSIT_REVIEW.rows(row(deposit=150, member=True, expect=True, why="members are not exempt"))
